warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 3.00 + 3.00 (6.00); y = A-B-C-D at 3.30 + 4.50 + 2.50 (10.30). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, both S-02 views, S-03 and A-09. Vector CAD PDF with no text layer — every value read off the rendered page.

B'' (5.00) is the row printed as 1.70 + 2.80 between B and C on S-01, S-02 and S-03: a real row of footings, columns and beams, but not a named grid. It is B'' rather than B' because the Truss T1 chain puts a tick at 4.15 (0.85 below B) earlier in the same gap — dummy names follow position order (section 4), so every plan ref to this row is B''.

Truss T1 (S-03) prints its panel chain against the A-D markers: 0.95 | 1.10 x3 | 0.85 x2 | 0.93 x3 | 0.83 x3 | 0.95, sub-totals 3.30 | 1.70 | 2.80 | 2.50, total 10.30. Every tick became a line per section 4 rule 4 (A'', A'''', A''''', B', B''', B'''', C', C'', D'). Inner ticks are positioned off the upper line (B''+0.93/+1.86, C+0.83/+1.66); 0.93 x3 = 2.79 and 0.83 x3 = 2.49 against printed sub-totals 2.80/2.50 — a 0.01 rounding in the drawing, absorbed by the last segment of each group.

A' (-1.00) vs A'' (-0.95) and D' (11.25) vs D'' (11.30) are 0.05 apart — kept both: they are different edges (A'/D'' = roof/rafter edge, 1.00 overhang on the S-03 plan; A''/D' = Truss T1 top-chord end, 0.95 overhang on the truss elevation).

z: ±0.00 = ระดับดินถม (A-09). ระดับดินเดิม (S-04 footing details) and ระดับดิน (S-05 step sections) print no value, so they are kept as levels with level_m null and the 1.00 / 0.50 / 0.05 / 0.05 footing depths stay on the footing elements (S-04 file), not as z ticks.

A-11 (stair ST-04 detail, extracted as a section) prints its plan chains against grid 2 and the A/B markers: 2' (4.10) and 2'' (4.70) on x, and a 1.00 tick below A that takes the name A''' (the truss ticks at 1.10 / 2.20 follow as A'''' / A'''''). Its section chains (0.888 + 2.663 = 3.550 rise, 2.300 + 1.000 = 3.300 run, riser 0.222, tread 0.200) carry no grid marker or level label, so they stay on the ST-04 element.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-06 plus A-09 (building section, for levels) and A-11 (stair detail). The other architectural/MEP sheets (A-03..A-08, A-10, A-12..A-14, E-01..E-02, SN-01..SN-03) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run; A-03 repeats the 1.60 + 1.40 x row and the 1.70 + 2.80 y row and carries room-tag levels (+0.54 ห้องน้ำ/ระเบียง/ครัว, +0.10 ซักล้าง, +3.99 attic bathroom/เฉลียง) that are not recorded here. S-04..S-06 print only member-internal dimensions (section sizes, cap sizes, slab thicknesses), which stay on their elements.
